vol_rle_components — 3D rle_region op

• Data kinds: voxel → rle_region

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.vol_rle_components(vol_binary, connectivity=26) (implementation को सीधे call करना हो तो import volregion; volregion.vol_rle_components(vol_binary, connectivity=26), registry से लेना हो तो ops3d.get("vol_rle_components"))

उपयोग

binary volume को हर component के VolRLE regions में बाँटता है।

> नीचे का विस्तृत विवरण मूल text में है — सारांश और headings का अनुवाद हो चुका है।

*The* use case run-length regions exist for: holding every component of a segmentation as its own region at run-proportional cost, instead of one dense label volume or N dense masks. Uses the key structural fact that a run is x-connected, so a component label is constant along each run — the volume is labelled once (dense, same 6/18/26 semantics as volops.vol_label) and then each *run* is assigned by its first voxel's label; no per-component dense mask is ever built.

Returns a list of VolRLE ordered by label id (1..n). An empty mask returns an empty list.
